question.text: Let $f(x)=4$ and $f^{\prime}(x)=4$. Then $\operatorname{Lim}_{x \rightarrow 2} \frac{x f(2)-2 f(x)}{x-2}$ is given by

solution.text: We have, $\operatorname{Lim}_{x \rightarrow 2} \frac{x f(2)-2 f(x)}{x-2}\left(\frac{0}{0}\right)=\operatorname{Lim}_{x \rightarrow 2} f(2)-2 f^{\prime}(x)=f(2)-2 f^{\prime}(2)=4-2 \times 4=-4$
